content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Ordnance Factory Ambarnath MBBS Doctor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Ordnance Factory Ambarnath for various positions. It is a government organization located in Ambarnath, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is MBBS Doctor. Candidates with the required medical qualifications are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for MBBS Doctor?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the MBBS Doctor post in Ordnance Factory Ambarnath recruitment 2026. This offers a good opportunity for medical professionals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for Ordnance Factory Ambarnath Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for MBBS Doctor posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the MBBS Doctor posts is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates should report at the venue with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply for MBBS Doctor?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the MBBS Doctor post is 70 years. This allows experienced medical professionals to apply.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required qualification for the MBBS Doctor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree from an MCI Recognized Medical College of India and be a Registered Medical Practitioner to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the MBBS Doctor position?
faq.answer: The selected MBBS Doctor will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 75,000/- per month. This is a contractual position with attractive remuneration.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Ordnance Factory Ambarnath MBBS Doctor recruitment 2026. All candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job location for the MBBS Doctor post?
faq.answer: The job location for the MBBS Doctor post is Ambarnath, Maharashtra, with Pincode 421502. Selected candidates will be posted at Ordnance Factory Ambarnath.
